Name: Junimo Kart Cheater
Author: ryaon
Description:
Detail
[list]
[*]Once you press 'Jump' button(Spacebar, LeftmouseClick, etc) in each stage, your kart will fly to the sky and reach the end point.
[*]You have infinite lives.
[*]The kart speed is 5 times faster.
[/list]
Installation
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI.[i] (tested with SMAPI 3.0.1 & StardewValley 1.4.3)[/i]
[*]Unpack the mod files into their own directory inside (..\StardewValley\Mods)
[/list]
Uninstall
[list=1]
[*]Delete 'JunimoKartCheater' directory in '..\StardewValley\Mods'.
[/list]
Notes
[list]
[*]It's simply to make you just clear 'Junimo Kart' and no function of a 'game'.
[*]If you wanna have a fun or pleasure of clearing with Junimo Kart, don't use this mod.
[/list]
